symbol_matching: Exact uppercase RNA-export symbols; no alias inference or restriction to ChIP-annotated genes.

cell_fate.method: unweighted GSEA calibrated against empirical WT-versus-WT scores
cell_fate.BH_family: all eligible signatures and five contrasts, separately for each variant
cell_fate.WT_pvalue: (1 + same-sign tail exceedances) / (1 + same-sign WT scores)
cell_fate.WT_NES: observed ES / mean absolute same-sign WT ES
cell_fate.expression_mask: fixed observed-comparison eligible genes, reused for all WT assignments
cell_fate.representative_matching: preserve this release ranking and match to WT fits by Ensembl gene ID
cell_fate.preranked_reference: retained as diagnostic columns and archived original results

scope: Frozen 48h ChIP, original observed DE calls and cell-type library; empirical EOMES WT reference reconstructed from nine selected WT libraries and 1566 assignments; no observed DE refit.
